versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes detected in this version.

- No file changes or documentation updates.
- Functionality and interface remain the same as the previous version.

- Initial release of PulpMiner web scraper skill.
- Enables conversion of any webpage to structured JSON using AI.
- Supports custom JSON schemas, dynamic and static APIs, and programmatic API calls.
- Includes authentication via API key and dashboard-based API configuration.
- Offers options for JavaScript rendering, CSS selectors, response caching, and extra AI instructions.
- Provides free developer tools and integration guides for Zapier and n8n.
